desc: Define $L_i = H - D_i$ and $R_i = U_i$. The problem asks us to minimize the cost to make $U_i + D_i = H$ (constant) and $|U_i - U_{i+1}| \leq X$.
Implement the `check(H)` function with forward and backward interval propagation.
Implement the binary search over $H$ in the range $[1, 2 \cdot 10^9]$ to find the maximum valid $H$.
Calculate the total cost as $\sum (U_i + D_i) - N \times H_{max}$ and print it.
Write the complete solution reading from stdin and writing to stdout.
Run the code against Sample 1 to verify correctness.
Run the code against Sample 2, 3, and 4 to ensure robustness.
